name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 11 – Am 54
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 11c. Regrets that the European Court of Justice imposed a fine on Hungary for not letting migrants enter the country before a final decision is made on their application; requests that the Commission use part of the EUR 2 billion due for border protection expenses for Hungary to finance the fine imposed on Hungary by the European Court of Justice;
